rows.t1_final: K. Sriramakrishnaiah (1926‑2002) was a prominent irrigation engineer from Andhra Pradesh who worked on most of the state’s major irrigation projects for 34 years before retiring in 1983.  After retirement he served as an adviser on irrigation and water‑dispute matters, authored several books on water management, and received the National Hydrology Award (1987) and an honorary doctorate (1989).  In his honor a memorial trust was established, his birthday is celebrated as Irrigation Day in Andhra Pradesh, and a major reservoir was renamed after him.
